tools.name: instablog_auth_status
tools.description: Check if API key is configured and valid. Returns user info if authenticated.

tools.name: instablog_list_sites
tools.description: List all sites owned by the current user. Returns site IDs needed for other operations.

tools.name: instablog_select_site
tools.description: Select a site to work with. All subsequent operations will use this site.

tools.name: instablog_get_site
tools.description: Get details about the currently selected site.

tools.name: instablog_get_site_settings
tools.description: Get settings for the currently selected site including navigation, theme, colors, SEO, and social links.

tools.name: instablog_update_site_settings
tools.description:
Update site settings. Can modify theme, colors, SEO metadata, social links, fonts, banner, and more.
    Use this for general settings updates. For navigation, prefer instablog_update_navigation or instablog_update_footer_navigation.

tools.name: instablog_update_navigation
tools.description:
Update the primary navigation menu for the site.
    Replaces the entire navigation array with the provided items.
    Each item needs a label and URL. Optional: slug and order.

tools.name: instablog_update_footer_navigation
tools.description:
Update the footer navigation menu for the site.
    Replaces the entire footer navigation array with the provided items.
    Each item needs a label and URL. Optional: slug and order.

tools.name: instablog_update_redirects
tools.description:
Configure 301 (permanent) redirects for the site.
    Replaces the entire redirects list with the provided rules. Useful when migrating from another platform to preserve SEO of old URLs.
    Each rule needs a source (path starting with "/", no query string) and a destination (internal path "/..." or absolute http(s) URL).
    Max 250 rules. Sources must be unique; self-loops and redirect cycles are rejected.

source.description: Source path to redirect from (must start with "/", no query string), e.g. /old-article

destination.description: Destination path ("/...") or absolute http(s) URL, e.g. /new-article

tools.name: instablog_list_posts
tools.description:
List posts from the selected site. Supports filtering and pagination.
    Use status filter to get only drafts, published, etc.
    Returns basic info - use instablog_get_post to get full content.

tools.name: instablog_list_all_posts
tools.description:
Fetch ALL posts from the site (handles pagination automatically).
    Use this when you need to review/analyze all articles.
    Warning: May be slow for sites with many posts.

tools.name: instablog_get_post
tools.description: Get full details of a post including its HTML content, metadata, tags, and category.

tools.name: instablog_create_post
tools.description: Create a new post/article on the selected site.

tools.name: instablog_update_post
tools.description:
Update an existing post. Can modify content, metadata, status, slug, primary keyword, etc.
    Use this to fix SEO issues, update content, change metadata, swap the targeted keyword, or fix slug after title change.
    The primaryKeyword is normalized server-side (trimmed + lowercased).

tools.name: instablog_delete_post
tools.description: Delete a post permanently.

tools.name: instablog_update_post_faq
tools.description:
Patch the FAQ section of a post. Replaces existing FAQ items with the provided list.
    Pass an empty array to remove all FAQ items, or null to clear the FAQ field.

faq.description: Array of FAQ items, or null to clear

tools.name: instablog_set_post_tags
tools.description: Set tags for a post (replaces existing tags).

tagIds.description: Array of tag IDs to set

tools.name: instablog_assign_post_to_cluster
tools.description:
Assign a post to a topic cluster and/or set its content type in the content map.
    This is what lets you organize a post into the topical structure shown by instablog_get_content_map.
    - cluster: the cluster slug to assign (auto-created if it doesn't exist); pass null to clear it.
    - contentType: "pillar" (the main comprehensive article), "supporting", or "standalone".
    Marking a post as "pillar" while it has a cluster also registers it as that cluster's pillar.
    To change the targeted keyword of a post, use instablog_update_post (primaryKeyword field).

tools.name: instablog_list_tags
tools.description: List all tags for the selected site.

tools.name: instablog_list_all_tags
tools.description: Fetch ALL tags from the site (handles pagination automatically).

tools.name: instablog_create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag.

tools.name: instablog_update_tag
tools.description: Update a tag (name, description, SEO metadata).

tools.name: instablog_list_categories
tools.description: List all categories for the selected site.

tools.name: instablog_list_all_categories
tools.description: Fetch ALL categories from the site.

tools.name: instablog_create_category
tools.description: Create a new category.

tools.name: instablog_update_category
tools.description: Update a category (name, description, SEO metadata).

tools.name: instablog_generate_categories
tools.description: Auto-generate categories using AI based on site settings.

tools.name: instablog_list_topics
tools.description: List topics (article ideas) for the selected site.

tools.name: instablog_list_all_topics
tools.description: Fetch ALL topics from the site (handles pagination automatically).

tools.name: instablog_get_topic
tools.description: Get details of a specific topic.

tools.name: instablog_create_topic
tools.description:
Create a new topic (article idea).

    Article types:
    - guide: Comprehensive long-form content (subtypes: definition, explainer, how-to, comparison, review)
    - listicle: Numbered list content (subtypes: examples, roundup, resources)
    - news: Timely news articles (subtypes: news-discover)

tools.name: instablog_update_topic
tools.description: Update a topic.

tools.name: instablog_delete_topic
tools.description: Delete a topic.

tools.name: instablog_generate_topics
tools.description:
Generate new topic ideas using AI.
    Sources:
    - ai: Generate based on site context and optional theme
    - competitors: Research competitor blogs
    - news: Research industry news

tools.name: instablog_generate_post_from_topic
tools.description:
Create a post from a topic and start content generation.
    This creates a new post linked to the topic and optionally starts full content generation.

tools.name: instablog_clear_all_topics
tools.description: Delete ALL topics for the site. Use with caution!

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion

tools.name: instablog_audit_post
tools.description:
Run a full audit on a post. Checks for:
    - SEO issues (meta tags, headings, keyword density)
    - Content quality (length, readability, AI patterns)
    - Source verification (citations, missing sources)
    - Structure (heading hierarchy, paragraphs)
    - Type-specific requirements (comparison tables, how-to steps, etc.)
    Returns issues found with severity and suggestions.

tools.name: instablog_get_post_score
tools.description:
Get the unified dimensional score for a post.
    Score breakdown:
    - SEO Technical (25%): H1, meta, headings, keyword density
    - Content Quality (30%): Length, readability, AI patterns
    - Citations (20%): Source attribution, external links
    - Internal Linking (15%): Min 3 links, anchor quality
    - Disclosure (10%): AI disclosure presence

tools.name: instablog_fix_audit_issues
tools.description:
Auto-fix issues found in audit.
    Set applyDirectly=false to preview fixes first.
    Set applyDirectly=true to apply fixes immediately.
    Optionally filter by specific issue types.

tools.name: instablog_rollback_audit_fixes
tools.description: Rollback the last audit fixes applied to a post.

tools.name: instablog_bulk_audit
tools.description:
Start a bulk audit for all posts on the site.
    Returns a task ID to track progress.

tools.name: instablog_get_audit_metrics
tools.description: Get aggregate content metrics for the site (scores, issue distribution, etc.).

tools.name: instablog_generate_post_content
tools.description:
Start AI content generation for a post.
    Modes:
    - outline_only: Generate outline and stop for review
    - full: Generate complete article (outline + content)

    Speed:
    - fast: Quick generation, good for drafts
    - quality: Higher quality, more research

    Returns a task ID. Use instablog_generation_status to track progress.

tools.name: instablog_generation_status
tools.description: Get the current status of content generation for a post.

tools.name: instablog_get_task_status
tools.description:
Get the status of an async background task by its task ID.
    Use this to poll long-running operations that return a taskId, such as
    instablog_rebuild_content_map or instablog_bulk_audit.
    Status is one of: pending, processing, completed, failed, stopped, not_found.
    When completed, the task result (if any) is included.

taskId.description: The task ID returned by an async operation

tools.name: instablog_stop_generation
tools.description: Request to stop an ongoing generation gracefully (completes current step).

tools.name: instablog_force_stop_generation
tools.description: Force stop a generation immediately. Use with caution.

tools.name: instablog_get_content_guidelines
tools.description:
Get content generation guidelines and best practices.
    IMPORTANT: Call this tool BEFORE creating or editing any content.
    CRITICAL: All articles MUST be in HTML format - NEVER use Markdown unless explicitly requested.
    Returns language rules, SEO best practices, E-E-A-T guidelines, and writing standards.

tools.name: instablog_gsc_get_connection
tools.description: Get the Google Search Console connection status for the selected site. Returns connection details including linked GSC properties and sync status.

tools.name: instablog_gsc_get_overview
tools.description: Get Google Search Console analytics overview for the selected site. Returns total clicks, impressions, CTR, average position, and daily trend data.

tools.name: instablog_gsc_get_top_pages
tools.description: Get top performing pages from Google Search Console for the selected site. Returns pages sorted by clicks with their performance metrics.

tools.name: instablog_gsc_get_top_queries
tools.description: Get top search queries from Google Search Console for the selected site. Returns queries that users searched to find your site, sorted by clicks.

tools.name: instablog_get_content_map
tools.description:
Get the content map for the selected site.
    Returns content with their keywords, topics, and cluster assignments.
    By default only PUBLISHED content is returned (archived/draft entries are excluded).
    Pass status to widen or change the filter. Use this to understand the site's
    content structure and identify gaps.

tools.name: instablog_get_cluster_stats
tools.description:
Get cluster statistics for the selected site.
    Each cluster includes its human title, post count, pillar status + pillar post ID,
    target keywords, and the semantic topics covered.
    Useful for understanding topical coverage and identifying clusters needing more content.

tools.name: instablog_check_cannibalization
tools.description:
Check if a proposed topic would cannibalize existing content.
    Use this BEFORE creating new content to avoid keyword/topic overlap.
    Returns the overlap risk, the most similar existing posts, and a recommended action.

tools.name: instablog_rebuild_content_map
tools.description:
Rebuild the content map for all published content.
    Use this after bulk content changes or to fix inconsistencies. It also prunes
    stale entries (archived/unpublished posts) from the map.
    Runs asynchronously (AI keyword extraction per post) and returns a task ID —
    poll it with instablog_get_task_status to know when it has finished.

tools.name: instablog_get_content_strategy
tools.description:
Get the content strategy for the selected site.
    Returns topic clusters, content mix targets, strategy rules, and live coverage stats.
    Use this to understand the site's content planning and cluster organization.

tools.name: instablog_update_content_strategy
tools.description:
Update content strategy settings (content mix, rules, notes).
    Use this to adjust the overall content planning parameters.

tools.name: instablog_add_cluster
tools.description:
Add a new topic cluster to the content strategy.
    A cluster groups related content around a central theme with a pillar article.

tools.name: instablog_update_cluster
tools.description:
Update an existing topic cluster.
    Use this to modify cluster settings, keywords, or assign a pillar article.

tools.name: instablog_remove_cluster
tools.description:
Remove a topic cluster from the content strategy.
    This does NOT delete the posts, only removes the cluster grouping.

tools.name: instablog_get_strategy_health
tools.description:
Get a health report for the content strategy.
    Analyzes cluster coverage, content mix deviation, and provides recommendations.
    Use this to identify areas needing attention.

tools.name: instablog_get_topic_suggestions
tools.description:
Get suggested next topics based on the content strategy.
    Returns prioritized topic ideas that fill gaps in your content coverage.

tools.name: instablog_auto_generate_clusters
tools.description:
Auto-generate topic clusters from existing content using AI.
    Analyzes published posts to identify natural topic groupings.
    Use clearExisting=true to replace all existing clusters.

tools.name: instablog_generate_pillar
tools.description:
Generate a pillar article for a cluster.
    Creates a new comprehensive post and starts AI content generation.
    The pillar becomes the central hub for the cluster's topic.

tools.name: instablog_request_post_indexing
tools.description: Request search engine indexing for a specific published post. Submits the post URL to Google Indexing API and IndexNow (Bing/Yandex). The post must be published for indexing to work.

postId.description: The post ID to request indexing for

tools.name: instablog_request_site_indexing
tools.description: Request search engine indexing for ALL published posts on the selected site. Submits all post URLs to Google Indexing API and IndexNow. Use this to bulk-index all content after initial setup or when IndexNow key is first configured.

tools.name: instablog_list_site_keywords
tools.description:
List keywords stored for the selected site, with filters and pagination.
    Returns search volume, difficulty, competition, intent, and whether each keyword is used by a post.
    Use this to inspect the keyword inventory or find unused opportunities.

tools.name: instablog_explore_keywords
tools.description:
Explore new keyword ideas for the selected site using DataForSEO.
    Pass a seed query and (optionally) language/location. Returns keyword candidates with search volume,
    difficulty, competition, and intent. Newly fetched keywords are cached for the site.

searchQuery.description: Seed query, topic, or keyword to expand

tools.name: instablog_remove_site_keyword
tools.description:
Remove the association between a keyword and the selected site.
    This does not delete posts that use the keyword — it only clears the site_keywords entry
    so the keyword stops appearing in this site's inventory.
